correctness.rationale: For real BV data on (0,1), differentiating the Neumann drift generator maps its spatial derivative measure through the strictly positive Dirichlet heat kernel with the same +b drift. Integration of positive columns proves the exact operator norm and delta-jump attainment, and unique maximizing column mass forces exactly one atom for equality. The column mass is killed Brownian survival with adjoint drift -b, log-concave by finite-grid Gaussian Prékopa and analytic, hence uniquely maximized. The gauge-transformed sine expansion is exact; two first-passage Gaussian tails yield y=1/2+bt+O_b(t²) and the drift-neutral exponential deficit. The first two sine modes yield the exact first displacement correction at infinity, including correct eigenvalue normalization. A standalone independent quadrature and spectral numerical checker passed; finite tests are supplementary.

value.rationale: Exact positive-time BV stability of a canonical reflecting diffusion is not given by qualitative gradient contraction. Its unique optimizing discontinuity moves with drift and observation time, but the leading exponentially small onset is drift-independent; the first correction to its long-time position has a closed coefficient. These features motivate a natural sharp semigroup invariant, distinguish unequal-domain/boundary effects from periodic smoothing and provide quantitative benchmarks for variation-sensitive diffusion approximation. No general downstream theorem is required for this complete natural classification.
